tools.name: myclub_get_club
tools.description: Show basic information about the club: name, domain and settings. Good first call to confirm the connection. myClub API: GET /club.

tools.name: myclub_list_events
tools.description: List club events, with optional filters for dates, group, venue and changes since a time. myClub API: GET /events.

tools.name: myclub_get_event
tools.description: Show one event by id, including its times, venue, registration settings and participants. myClub API: GET /events/{id}.

tools.name: myclub_list_courses
tools.description: List club courses (recurring classes or training series), with optional filters. myClub API: GET /courses.

tools.name: myclub_get_course
tools.description: Show one course by id, including its schedule, visibility and participants. myClub API: GET /courses/{id}.

tools.name: myclub_list_members
tools.description: List club members, one page at a time. Member data may be shown only as each member's privacy setting allows. myClub API: GET /members/.

tools.name: myclub_search_members
tools.description: Find club members by first and last name. Both names are required. myClub API: GET /members/search.

tools.name: myclub_get_member
tools.description: Show one member by id, within the member's privacy setting. myClub API: GET /members/{id}.

tools.name: myclub_list_groups
tools.description: List the club's groups (teams, sections or departments). myClub API: GET /groups.

tools.name: myclub_list_group_memberships
tools.description: List the memberships of one group. myClub API: GET /groups/{id}/memberships.

tools.name: myclub_list_venues
tools.description: List the club's venues. Use a venue id when you create or update an event. myClub API: GET /venues.

tools.name: myclub_list_event_categories
tools.description: List the club's event categories. Use a category id when you create or update an event. myClub API: GET /event_categories.

tools.name: myclub_list_notifications
tools.description: List club notifications (news posts for members), with optional group filter. myClub API: GET /notifications.

tools.name: myclub_create_event
tools.description: Create a club event. Name, start, end, venue and group are required. Writes to the club's live calendar. myClub API: POST /events.

tools.name: myclub_update_event
tools.description: Change fields of an event. Only the event's creator (the API user) may update it; send only the fields to change. myClub API: PUT /events/{id}.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: myclub_list_notifications · Public sink: myclub_create_event, myclub_update_event.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: myclub_list_notifications · Public sink: myclub_create_event, myclub_update_event

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
